Billing for subscriptions and utilities

Bills go out to thousands of customers every month, payments come in through Click and Payme, and debtors get reminders, all without Excel. Qilich builds the MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 120 mln; the full version in 14–24 weeks.

Questions

What does “Billing for subscriptions and utilities” cost?
At Qilich the MVP costs $10,000–20,000 (UZS 120–245 mln) and the full version $28,000–60,000 (UZS 335–725 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Billing for subscriptions and utilities” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 6–10 weeks and the full version in 14–24 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “Billing for subscriptions and utilities”?
How the work runs today: who does what; existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system; 1–2 staff to try the system.
